description: Species with wide inter-point spacing (median NN distance >20px): Plegadis chihi (26-37px) and Coscoroba coscoroba (120-220px), pooled as one generic 'bird' detector across 3 training photos from 2 different sessions/camera setups (regular photo + stitched aerial panoramas). Held out: IMG_4148.jpeg (Plegadis chihi), the same held-out image used by the earlier species-specific Pair A experiment, for direct before/after comparison.
